experiments.name: kill-payment-service-pods-mid-checkout
experiments.description: Terminates payment-service pods during active checkout traffic to verify outbox pattern & idempotency hold without double-charging

targetResolution.expectedBehavior: No double charge occurs; transactional outbox pattern guarantees single-delivery on pod recovery.

experiments.name: inject-latency-cart-catalog-dependency
experiments.description: Injects 500ms network latency between cart-service and catalog-service to verify P99 degraded bounds and ILIKE fallback

targetResolution.expectedBehavior: Cart service scan latency remains within degraded bounds (<200ms) with circuit breaking.

experiments.name: simulate-rds-multi-az-failover
experiments.description: Simulates RDS Multi-AZ failover during active checkout traffic to verify <30s pgxpool reconnection

targetResolution.expectedBehavior: pgxpool automatically reconnects within 30 seconds without hanging connections.
